Message:
net: mvpp2: fix MVPP21_ISR_RXQ_GROUP_REG definition

The MVPP21_ISR_RXQ_GROUP_REG register is not indexed by rxq, but by
port, so we fix the parameter name accordingly. There are no
functional changes.
